# The oracle matrix of the functions of the `pandoc` Lua module.
# `tools/module-matrix.py` writes this file. Do not edit it.
@@@ doc empty
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{},"blocks":[]}
@@@ doc small
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}
@@@ filter utils-roman empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(0)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(0) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(1)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(1) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(3)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(3) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(4)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(4) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(9)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(9) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(14)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(14) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(40)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(40) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(49)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(49) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(90)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(90) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(400)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(400) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(944)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(944) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(1994)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(1994) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(2024)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(2024) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(3999)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(3999) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(4000)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(4000) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(5000)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(5000) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(-1)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(-1) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(-4000)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(-4000) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(2.0)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(2.0) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(1.5)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(1.5) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(\03912\039)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral('12') end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(\039 7 \039)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(' 7 ') end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(\039x\039)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral('x') end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(\0390x10\039)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral('0x10') end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(nil)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(nil) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral()', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral() end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral({})', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral({}) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(true)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(true) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(math.maxinteger)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(math.maxinteger) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(math.mininteger)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(math.mininteger) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(2^53)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(2^53) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(1e300)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(1e300) end)
  probe('P.utils.to_roman_numeral(0/0)', function() return P.utils.to_roman_numeral(0/0) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))

local function run(document)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(\039\039)', function() return P.utils.sha1('') end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(\039abc\039)', function() return P.utils.sha1('abc') end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(\039\092195\092169\039)', function() return P.utils.sha1('\195\169') end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(12)', function() return P.utils.sha1(12) end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(1.5)', function() return P.utils.sha1(1.5) end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(string.rep(\039a\039, 55))', function() return P.utils.sha1(string.rep('a', 55)) end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(string.rep(\039a\039, 56))', function() return P.utils.sha1(string.rep('a', 56)) end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(string.rep(\039a\039, 63))', function() return P.utils.sha1(string.rep('a', 63)) end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(string.rep(\039a\039, 64))', function() return P.utils.sha1(string.rep('a', 64)) end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(string.rep(\039ab\039, 500))', function() return P.utils.sha1(string.rep('ab', 500)) end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(\039\0920\039)', function() return P.utils.sha1('\0') end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1()', function() return P.utils.sha1() end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(nil)', function() return P.utils.sha1(nil) end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1({})', function() return P.utils.sha1({}) end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(true)', function() return P.utils.sha1(true) end)
  probe('P.utils.sha1(P.Str\039x\039)', function() return P.utils.sha1(P.Str'x') end)
  probe('P.sha1(\039abc\039)', function() return P.sha1('abc') end)
  probe('P.sha1()', function() return P.sha1() end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\03900/10/2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('00/10/2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\03901/01/00\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('01/01/00') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\039\092217\092162\092217\092160\092217\092162\092217\092163\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('\217\162\217\160\217\162\217\163') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\039\092239\092188\092146\092239\092188\092144\092239\092188\092146\092239\092188\092147\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('\239\188\146\239\188\144\239\188\146\239\188\147') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\03931 February 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('31 February 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\0395\092194\092160January 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('5\194\160January 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\0395\092226\092128\092131January 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('5\226\128\131January 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\0395\092194\092133January 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('5\194\133January 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\0395\092226\092128\092168January 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('5\226\128\168January 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\03901/05/23x\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('01/05/23x') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\039January 005, 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('January 005, 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\0391 Jan. 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('1 Jan. 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\03999999999999999999999999\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('99999999999999999999999') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\039Dec. 31, 9999\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('Dec. 31, 9999') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\039Mar 1, 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('Mar 1, 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\039Oct 10 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('Oct 10 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\039  \092010 \039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('  \010 ') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\039January 0005, 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('January 0005, 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\0390005 January 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('0005 January 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\039January 105, 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('January 105, 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\039Jan. 0031, 2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('Jan. 0031, 2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\03901/005/2023\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('01/005/2023') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(\0392023-001-05\039)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date('2023-001-05') end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(2023)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date(2023) end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(2023.0)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date(2023.0) end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(20230105)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date(20230105) end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date()', function() return P.utils.normalize_date() end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(nil)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date(nil) end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date({})', function() return P.utils.normalize_date({}) end)
  probe('P.utils.normalize_date(true)', function() return P.utils.normalize_date(true) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter utils-blocks-to-inlines empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function blocks()
  return {
    P.Plain{t'plain'}, P.Para{t'para'}, P.LineBlock{{t'l1'}, {t'l2'}},
    P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('i', {'c'})), P.RawBlock('html', '<b>'),
    P.BlockQuote{P.Para{t'q1'}, P.Para{t'q2'}},
    P.OrderedList{{P.Plain{t'o1'}}, {P.Para{t'o2'}, P.Para{t'o3'}}},
    P.BulletList{{P.Plain{t'b1'}}, {P.Plain{t'b2'}}},
    P.DefinitionList{{{t'term'}, {{P.Plain{t'd1'}}, {P.Para{t'd2'}}}}},
    P.Header(2, {t'head'}, P.Attr('hid')), P.HorizontalRule(),
    P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'cap'}}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}},
      P.TableHead{P.Row{cell'h'}},
      {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{cell'c'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}},
      P.TableFoot()),
    P.Figure({P.Plain{t'fig'}}, P.Caption({P.Plain{t'fc'}})),
    P.Div({P.Para{t'div1'}, P.Para{t'div2'}}, P.Attr('d')),
  }
end

local function run(document)
  probe('kind 1', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[1]} end)
  probe('kind 2', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[2]} end)
  probe('kind 3', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[3]} end)
  probe('kind 4', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[4]} end)
  probe('kind 5', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[5]} end)
  probe('kind 6', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[6]} end)
  probe('kind 7', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[7]} end)
  probe('kind 8', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[8]} end)
  probe('kind 9', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[9]} end)
  probe('kind 10', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[10]} end)
  probe('kind 11', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[11]} end)
  probe('kind 12', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[12]} end)
  probe('kind 13', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[13]} end)
  probe('kind 14', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{blocks()[14]} end)
  probe('kind 1 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[1], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 2 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[2], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 3 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[3], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 4 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[4], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 5 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[5], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 6 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[6], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 7 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[7], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 8 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[8], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 9 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[9], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 10 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[10], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 11 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[11], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 12 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[12], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 13 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[13], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('kind 14 then para', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({blocks()[14], P.Para{t'after'}}) end)
  probe('all with sep', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines(blocks(), {t'|', P.Space()}) end)
  probe('empty', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{} end)
  probe('sep', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a'}, P.Para{t'b'}, P.Para{t'c'}}, {t'|', P.Space()}) end)
  probe('sep string', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a'}, P.Para{t'b'}}, 'xx') end)
  probe('sep empty', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a'}, P.Para{t'b'}}, {}) end)
  probe('sep nil', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a'}, P.Para{t'b'}}, nil) end)
  probe('sep inline', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a'}, P.Para{t'b'}}, P.Space()) end)
  probe('sep Inlines', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a'}, P.Para{t'b'}}, P.Inlines{t'-'}) end)
  probe('sep number', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a'}}, 5) end)
  probe('sep bad item', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a'}}, {'x'}) end)
  probe('block argument', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines(P.Para{t'a'}) end)
  probe('Blocks argument', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines(P.Blocks{P.Para{t'a'}, P.Plain{t'b'}}) end)
  probe('string argument', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines('text') end)
  probe('no argument', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines() end)
  probe('inline item', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{t'x'} end)
  probe('string item', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{'x'} end)
  probe('type', function() return P.utils.type(P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{P.Para{t'a'}}) end)
  probe('nested', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{P.Div{P.Div{P.Para{t'x'}}, P.BulletList{{P.Div{P.Plain{t'y'}, P.Plain{t'z'}}}}}} end)
  probe('empty blocks', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{P.Plain{}, P.Para{}, P.Div{}} end)
  probe('no merge inside', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{P.Para{t'a', t'b'}} end)
  probe('space line break', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{P.Para{t'a', P.Space()}, P.Para{P.Space(), t'b'}} end)
  probe('emph merge', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{P.Emph{t'a'}}, P.Para{P.Emph{t'b'}}}, {}) end)
  probe('smallcaps', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{P.SmallCaps{t'a'}}, P.Para{P.SmallCaps{t'b'}}}, {}) end)
  probe('each merge', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Plain{P.Underline{t'a'}, P.Subscript{t'b'}, P.Superscript{t'c'}, P.Strikeout{t'd'}, P.Strong{t'e'}}, P.Plain{P.Underline{t'a'}}, P.Plain{P.Subscript{t'b'}}, P.Plain{P.Superscript{t'c'}}, P.Plain{P.Strikeout{t'd'}}}, {}) end)
  probe('strong merge', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Plain{P.Strong{t'e'}}, P.Plain{P.Strong{t'f'}}}, {}) end)
  probe('space space', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a', P.Space()}, P.Para{P.Space(), t'b'}}, {P.Space()}) end)
  probe('soft breaks', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a', P.SoftBreak()}, P.Para{P.Space(), t'b'}, P.Para{P.SoftBreak()}, P.Para{P.SoftBreak()}}, {}) end)
  probe('space soft', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a', P.Space()}, P.Para{P.SoftBreak(), t'b'}}, {}) end)
  probe('break pairs', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a', P.LineBreak()}, P.Para{P.SoftBreak(), t'b', P.SoftBreak()}, P.Para{P.LineBreak()}, P.Para{P.Space()}}, {}) end)
  probe('break break', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a', P.LineBreak()}, P.Para{P.SoftBreak(), t'b'}}) end)
  probe('nested sep', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.BlockQuote{P.Para{t'q1'}, P.Para{t'q2'}}, P.Para{t'x'}}, {t'|'}) end)
  probe('div sep', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Div{P.Para{t'q1'}, P.Para{t'q2'}}}, {t'|'}) end)
  probe('list sep', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.BulletList{{P.Para{t'a1'}, P.Para{t'a2'}}, {P.Para{t'b'}}}}, {t'|'}) end)
  probe('line block sep', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.LineBlock{{t'l1'}, {t'l2'}}}, {t'|'}) end)
  probe('line block spaces', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{P.LineBlock{{t'l1', P.Space()}, {P.Space(), t'l2'}, {}, {t'l3'}}} end)
  probe('line block strs', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{P.LineBlock{{t'a'}, {}}, P.LineBlock{{}, {t'b'}}} end)
  probe('definitions', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.DefinitionList{{{t'term'}, {{P.Para{t'd1'}, P.Para{t'd1b'}}, {P.Para{t'd2'}}}}, {{t'two', P.Space()}, {}}}}, {t'|'}) end)
  probe('table full', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'cap'}}, {t'sh'}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}},
      P.TableHead{P.Row{cell'h1', cell'h2'}, P.Row{cell'h3', cell'h4'}},
      {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{cell'c1', cell'c2'}, P.Row{cell'c3', cell'c4'}}, head = {P.Row{cell'i1', cell'i2'}}, row_head_columns = 0},
       {attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{cell'd1', cell'd2'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}},
      P.TableFoot{P.Row{cell'f1', cell'f2'}})}, {t'|'}) end)
  probe('table empty', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Table(P.Caption(), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead(), {}, P.TableFoot())}, {t'|'}) end)
  probe('table empty rows', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{P.Table(P.Caption(), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{}, P.Row{}}, {}, P.TableFoot{P.Row{cell'f'}})} end)
  probe('table cell paras', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Table(P.Caption(), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead(), {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell{P.Para{t'p1'}, P.Para{t'p2'}}}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot())}, {t'|'}) end)
  probe('table spaces', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{P.Table(P.Caption(), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{P.Cell{P.Plain{t'a', P.Space()}}}, P.Row{P.Cell{P.Plain{P.Space(), t'b'}}}}, {}, P.TableFoot())} end)
  probe('figure', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Figure({P.Para{t'f1'}, P.Para{t'f2'}}, P.Caption({P.Plain{t'fc'}}))}, {t'|'}) end)
  probe('empty item', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.OrderedList{{P.Plain{t'a'}}, {}, {P.Plain{t'b'}}}}, {t'|'}) end)
  probe('one block sep', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a'}}, {P.Space(), t'x'}) end)
  probe('sep spaces', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a'}, P.Para{t'b'}}, {P.Space(), t'x', P.Space()}) end)
  probe('sep soft', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Para{t'a', P.Space()}, P.Para{t'b'}}, {P.Space(), t'x', P.SoftBreak()}) end)
  probe('rule middle', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Plain{t'a'}, P.HorizontalRule(), P.Plain{t'b'}}, {}) end)
  probe('emph lists', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.Plain{P.Emph{t'a', t'b'}}, P.Plain{P.Emph{t'c'}}}, {}) end)
  probe('code merge', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines({P.CodeBlock('a'), P.CodeBlock('b')}, {}) end)
  probe('note kept', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines{P.Para{P.Note{P.Para{t'n'}}}} end)
  probe('pandoc argument', function() return P.utils.blocks_to_inlines(P.Pandoc{P.Para{t'a'}}) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter utils-sections empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function doc()
  return {P.Para{t'intro'}, H(1,'a', P.Attr('ida', {'c1'}, {k='v'})), P.Para{t'pa'},
    H(2,'b'), P.Para{t'pb'}, H(3,'c'), H(2,'d'), H(1,'e'), P.Para{t'pe'}}
end

local function run(document)
  probe('make_sections(false, nil, doc())', function() return P.utils.make_sections(false, nil, doc()) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, doc())', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, doc()) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, 2, doc())', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 2, doc()) end)
  probe('make_sections(false, 1, {H(3,\039x\039), H(5,\039y\039), H(4, \039z\039), H(2,\039w\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(false, 1, {H(3,'x'), H(5,'y'), H(4, 'z'), H(2,'w')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(3,\039x\039), H(5,\039y\039), H(4, \039z\039), H(2,\039w\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(3,'x'), H(5,'y'), H(4, 'z'), H(2,'w')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(1,\039x\039, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039unnumbered\039})), H(2,\039y\039), H(1, \039z\039), H(1,\039q\039, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039unlisted\039}))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(1,'x', P.Attr('', {'unnumbered'})), H(2,'y'), H(1, 'z'), H(1,'q', P.Attr('', {'unlisted'}))}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,\039in\039), P.Para{t\039p\039}}, P.Attr(\039dv\039, {\039x\039})), H(1,\039after\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,'in'), P.Para{t'p'}}, P.Attr('dv', {'x'})), H(1,'after')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,\039in\039), P.Para{t\039p\039}}, P.Attr(\039dv\039, {\039section\039}))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,'in'), P.Para{t'p'}}, P.Attr('dv', {'section'}))}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(1,\039x\039, P.Attr(\039\039, {}, {number=\0399\039})), H(1,\039y\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(1,'x', P.Attr('', {}, {number='9'})), H(1,'y')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, 0, {H(1,\039x\039), H(2,\039y\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 0, {H(1,'x'), H(2,'y')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, -1, {H(1,\039x\039), H(2,\039y\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, -1, {H(1,'x'), H(2,'y')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(\039yes\039, nil, {})', function() return P.utils.make_sections('yes', nil, {}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, \039x\039, {})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 'x', {}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil)', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil) end)
  probe('make_sections()', function() return P.utils.make_sections() end)
  probe('make_sections(nil, nil, {H(1,\039x\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(nil, nil, {H(1,'x')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(1, nil, {H(1,\039x\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(1, nil, {H(1,'x')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.BlockQuote{H(1,\039bq\039)}, H(1, \039y\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.BlockQuote{H(1,'bq')}, H(1, 'y')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, 1.0, {H(2,\039x\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 1.0, {H(2,'x')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, 1.5, {})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 1.5, {}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, \0392\039, {H(1,\039x\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, '2', {H(1,'x')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(0,\039zero\039), H(1,\039one\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(0,'zero'), H(1,'one')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(2,\039a\039), H(1,\039b\039), H(3, \039c\039), H(3, \039d\039), H(2, \039e\039), H(1, \039f\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(2,'a'), H(1,'b'), H(3, 'c'), H(3, 'd'), H(2, 'e'), H(1, 'f')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(2,\039in\039)}, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039section\039})), H(1,\039after\039), P.Div({H(2,\039in2\039)}, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039section\039}))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(2,'in')}, P.Attr('', {'section'})), H(1,'after'), P.Div({H(2,'in2')}, P.Attr('', {'section'}))}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,\039in\039, P.Attr(\039hid\039, {\039hc\039}, {a=\0391\039}))}, P.Attr(\039dv\039, {\039dc\039}, {b=\0392\039}))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,'in', P.Attr('hid', {'hc'}, {a='1'}))}, P.Attr('dv', {'dc'}, {b='2'}))}) end)

  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(1,\039a\039), P.Div({H(2,\039in\039)}), H(3,\039after-div\039), H(2, \039two\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(1,'a'), P.Div({H(2,'in')}), H(3,'after-div'), H(2, 'two')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, 1, {H(3,\039top\039), P.Div({H(2,\039deep\039)}), P.BlockQuote{H(1,\039bq\039)}})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 1, {H(3,'top'), P.Div({H(2,'deep')}), P.BlockQuote{H(1,'bq')}}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, 1, {H(3,\039top\039), P.Div({P.Para{}, H(2,\039deep\039)})})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 1, {H(3,'top'), P.Div({P.Para{}, H(2,'deep')})}) end)

  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(1,\039a\039, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039unnumbered\039})), H(1, \039b\039), H(2, \039c\039, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039unnumbered\039})), H(3, \039d\039), H(2, \039e\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(1,'a', P.Attr('', {'unnumbered'})), H(1, 'b'), H(2, 'c', P.Attr('', {'unnumbered'})), H(3, 'd'), H(2, 'e')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(1,\039a\039), H(1, \039b\039, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039-\039})), H(1, \039c\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(1,'a'), H(1, 'b', P.Attr('', {'-'})), H(1, 'c')}) end)

  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,\039in\039)}, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039section\039}, {number=\0397\039})), H(1, \039n\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,'in')}, P.Attr('', {'section'}, {number='7'})), H(1, 'n')}) end)

  probe('make_sections(true, 2, {})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 2, {}) end)

  probe('make_sections(true, 1, {H(3,\039top\039), P.BlockQuote{H(2,\039bq\039)}, P.Div({H(4, \039d\039)}), P.Div({P.Para{}, H(5,\039e\039)})})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 1, {H(3,'top'), P.BlockQuote{H(2,'bq')}, P.Div({H(4, 'd')}), P.Div({P.Para{}, H(5,'e')})}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,\039in\039, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039unnumbered\039})), H(2, \039x\039), H(1, \039y\039), P.Para{}})})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,'in', P.Attr('', {'unnumbered'})), H(2, 'x'), H(1, 'y'), P.Para{}})}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,\039in\039, P.Attr(\039h\039, {\039c\039}, {{\039number\039, \0395\039}, {\039z\039, \0391\039}}))}, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039d\039, \039c\039, \039section\039}, {{\039z\039, \0392\039}, {\039y\039, \0393\039}}))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,'in', P.Attr('h', {'c'}, {{'number', '5'}, {'z', '1'}}))}, P.Attr('', {'d', 'c', 'section'}, {{'z', '2'}, {'y', '3'}}))}) end)
  probe('make_sections(false, nil, {P.Div({H(1,\039in\039, P.Attr(\039h\039))}, P.Attr(\039d\039))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(false, nil, {P.Div({H(1,'in', P.Attr('h'))}, P.Attr('d'))}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(1, \039a\039), P.Para{t\039p\039}, P.Div({H(2, \039in\039), P.Para{t\039q\039}}), P.Para{t\039r\039}, H(2, \039b\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(1, 'a'), P.Para{t'p'}, P.Div({H(2, 'in'), P.Para{t'q'}}), P.Para{t'r'}, H(2, 'b')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(2, \039x\039)}), P.Div({H(1, \039y\039)})})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(2, 'x')}), P.Div({H(1, 'y')})}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, 1, {P.Div({H(3, \039x\039)}), H(2, \039y\039), P.OrderedList{{H(1, \039li\039)}}})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 1, {P.Div({H(3, 'x')}), H(2, 'y'), P.OrderedList{{H(1, 'li')}}}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Figure({H(1,\039f\039)}), P.Div({P.Div({H(1, \039dd\039)})}, P.Attr(\039outer\039))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Figure({H(1,'f')}), P.Div({P.Div({H(1, 'dd')})}, P.Attr('outer'))}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1, \039x\039), P.Div({H(1, \039y\039)})})})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1, 'x'), P.Div({H(1, 'y')})})}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,\039x\039), P.BlockQuote{H(1, \039q\039)}}, P.Attr(\039d\039))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,'x'), P.BlockQuote{H(1, 'q')}}, P.Attr('d'))}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(3,\039x\039), P.Para{P.Note{H(1, \039n\039)}}})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(3,'x'), P.Para{P.Note{H(1, 'n')}}}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, 1, {H(3,\039x\039), P.Para{P.Note{H(2, \039n\039)}}})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 1, {H(3,'x'), P.Para{P.Note{H(2, 'n')}}}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(2,\039x\039), H(3, \039y\039), P.Div({H(2, \039z\039)})}, P.Attr(\039d\039))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(2,'x'), H(3, 'y'), P.Div({H(2, 'z')})}, P.Attr('d'))}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(2,\039x\039), H(3, \039y\039), P.Div({H(3, \039z\039)})}, P.Attr(\039d\039))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(2,'x'), H(3, 'y'), P.Div({H(3, 'z')})}, P.Attr('d'))}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, 3, {H(1,\039x\039, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039unnumbered\039})), H(2, \039y\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 3, {H(1,'x', P.Attr('', {'unnumbered'})), H(2, 'y')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,\039x\039)}, P.Attr(\039\039, {}, {number=\0393\039})), H(1, \039y\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Div({H(1,'x')}, P.Attr('', {}, {number='3'})), H(1, 'y')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(2,\039x\039), P.Table(P.Caption({H(1, \039cap\039)}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead(), {}, P.TableFoot())})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(2,'x'), P.Table(P.Caption({H(1, 'cap')}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead(), {}, P.TableFoot())}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(2,\039x\039), P.Para{P.Emph{P.Note{H(1, \039n\039)}}}})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(2,'x'), P.Para{P.Emph{P.Note{H(1, 'n')}}}}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(2,\039x\039), P.DefinitionList{{{t\039term\039}, {{H(1, \039def\039)}}}}})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(2,'x'), P.DefinitionList{{{t'term'}, {{H(1, 'def')}}}}}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(1, \039x\039), P.Div({}), P.Div({P.Para{}}), H(1, \039y\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(1, 'x'), P.Div({}), P.Div({P.Para{}}), H(1, 'y')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {P.Para{t\039a\039}, P.Para{t\039b\039}})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {P.Para{t'a'}, P.Para{t'b'}}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, P.Blocks{H(1, \039x\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, P.Blocks{H(1, 'x')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, H(1, \039x\039))', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, H(1, 'x')) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {t\039x\039})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {t'x'}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(1, \039x\039, P.Attr(\039i\039, {\039unnumbered\039, \039unnumbered\039}, {number=\0391\039}))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(1, 'x', P.Attr('i', {'unnumbered', 'unnumbered'}, {number='1'}))}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, 5, {H(1, \039x\039), H(2, \039y\039), H(9, \039z\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, 5, {H(1, 'x'), H(2, 'y'), H(9, 'z')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, math.maxinteger, {H(1, \039x\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, math.maxinteger, {H(1, 'x')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(true, nil, {H(1, \039a\039), H(4, \039b\039), H(2, \039c\039), H(4, \039d\039), H(3, \039e\039), H(1, \039f\039), H(3, \039g\039)})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(true, nil, {H(1, 'a'), H(4, 'b'), H(2, 'c'), H(4, 'd'), H(3, 'e'), H(1, 'f'), H(3, 'g')}) end)
  probe('make_sections(false, nil, {P.Div({H(1, \039a\039), P.Para{t\039p\039}}, P.Attr(\039\039, {}, {number=\0394\039}))})', function() return P.utils.make_sections(false, nil, {P.Div({H(1, 'a'), P.Para{t'p'}}, P.Attr('', {}, {number='4'}))}) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter pandoc-normalize empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('normalize P.Para{t\039a\039, t\039b\039}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{t'a', t'b'}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Emph{t\039a\039, t\039b\039}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph{t'a', t'b'}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Link({t\039a\039, t\039b\039}, \039u\039)}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Link({t'a', t'b'}, 'u')}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Note{P.Para{t\039a\039, t\039b\039}}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Note{P.Para{t'a', t'b'}}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Space(), P.Space(), t\039a\039}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Space(), P.Space(), t'a'}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Emph{P.Space(), P.Space(), t\039a\039}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph{P.Space(), P.Space(), t'a'}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.SoftBreak(), P.SoftBreak(), t\039a\039}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.SoftBreak(), P.SoftBreak(), t'a'}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Emph{P.SoftBreak(), P.SoftBreak(), t\039a\039}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph{P.SoftBreak(), P.SoftBreak(), t'a'}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{t\039a\039, t\039\039}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{t'a', t''}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{t\039\039}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{t''}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{t\039\039, t\039\039}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{t'', t''}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Emph{t\039a\039}, P.Emph{t\039b\039}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph{t'a'}, P.Emph{t'b'}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Emph{t\039a\039}, P.Emph{t\039b\039, t\039c\039}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph{t'a'}, P.Emph{t'b', t'c'}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Strong{t\039a\039}, P.Strong{t\039b\039}, P.SmallCaps{t\039c\039}, P.SmallCaps{t\039d\039}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Strong{t'a'}, P.Strong{t'b'}, P.SmallCaps{t'c'}, P.SmallCaps{t'd'}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Underline{t\039a\039}, P.Underline{t\039b\039}, P.Strikeout{t\039c\039}, P.Strikeout{t\039d\039}, P.Subscript{t\039e\039}, P.Subscript{t\039f\039}, P.Superscript{t\039g\039}, P.Superscript{t\039h\039}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Underline{t'a'}, P.Underline{t'b'}, P.Strikeout{t'c'}, P.Strikeout{t'd'}, P.Subscript{t'e'}, P.Subscript{t'f'}, P.Superscript{t'g'}, P.Superscript{t'h'}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Space(), P.LineBreak(), P.Space(), P.SoftBreak(), P.LineBreak(), P.LineBreak(), P.SoftBreak(), P.Space()}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Space(), P.LineBreak(), P.Space(), P.SoftBreak(), P.LineBreak(), P.LineBreak(), P.SoftBreak(), P.Space()}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Span({t\039a\039}), P.Span({t\039b\039})}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Span({t'a'}), P.Span({t'b'})}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Quoted(\039DoubleQuote\039, {t\039a\039, t\039b\039})}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', {t'a', t'b'})}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Cite({t\039a\039, t\039b\039}, {P.Citation(\039k\039, \039NormalCitation\039, {t\039p\039, t\039q\039}, {P.Space(), P.Space()})})}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Cite({t'a', t'b'}, {P.Citation('k', 'NormalCitation', {t'p', t'q'}, {P.Space(), P.Space()})})}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Image({t\039a\039, t\039b\039}, \039u\039)}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Image({t'a', t'b'}, 'u')}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Header(1, {t\039a\039, t\039b\039})', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Header(1, {t'a', t'b'})}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Plain{t\039a\039, t\039b\039}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.LineBlock{{t\039a\039, t\039b\039}, {P.Space(), P.Space()}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.LineBlock{{t'a', t'b'}, {P.Space(), P.Space()}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.DefinitionList{{{t\039a\039, t\039b\039}, {{P.Plain{t\039c\039, t\039d\039}}}}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.DefinitionList{{{t'a', t'b'}, {{P.Plain{t'c', t'd'}}}}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Div{P.BlockQuote{P.Para{t\039a\039, t\039b\039}}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Div{P.BlockQuote{P.Para{t'a', t'b'}}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.BulletList{{P.Plain{t\039a\039, t\039b\039}}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.BulletList{{P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Figure({P.Plain{t\039a\039, t\039b\039}}, P.Caption({P.Plain{t\039c\039, t\039d\039}}, {t\039e\039, t\039f\039}))', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Figure({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}, P.Caption({P.Plain{t'c', t'd'}}, {t'e', t'f'}))}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Emph{P.Emph{t\039a\039, t\039b\039}, P.Emph{t\039c\039}}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph{P.Emph{t'a', t'b'}, P.Emph{t'c'}}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Code(\039a\039), P.Code(\039b\039), P.Math(\039InlineMath\039, \039x\039)}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Code('a'), P.Code('b'), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x')}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Str\039a\039, P.Emph{}, P.Str\039b\039}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'a', P.Emph{}, P.Str'b'}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize P.Para{P.Emph{}, P.Emph{}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph{}, P.Emph{}}}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize table {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignRight, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{cell\039a\039}}, {}, P.TableFoot()', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignRight, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{cell'a'}}, {}, P.TableFoot())}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize table {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{cell\039a\039, cell\039b\039, cell\039c\039}}, {}, P.TableFoot()', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{cell'a', cell'b', cell'c'}}, {}, P.TableFoot())}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize table {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{P.Cell({P.Plain\039x\039}, \039AlignDefault\039, 2, 2), cell\039b\039}, P.Row{cell\039c\039, cell\039d\039}, P.Row{cell\039e\039}}, {}, P.TableFoot()', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{P.Cell({P.Plain'x'}, 'AlignDefault', 2, 2), cell'b'}, P.Row{cell'c', cell'd'}, P.Row{cell'e'}}, {}, P.TableFoot())}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize table {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{P.Cell({}, \039AlignDefault\039, 5, 0)}, P.Row{P.Cell({}, \039AlignDefault\039, -2, 7)}}, {}, P.TableFoot()', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{P.Cell({}, 'AlignDefault', 5, 0)}, P.Row{P.Cell({}, 'AlignDefault', -2, 7)}}, {}, P.TableFoot())}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize table {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead(), {{attr = P.Attr(), row_head_columns = 2, head = {P.Row{cell\039h\039}}, body = {P.Row{P.Cell({}, \039AlignDefault\039, 1, 3), cell\039x\039}, P.Row{cell\039a\039, cell\039b\039, cell\039c\039, cell\039d\039}}}}, P.TableFoot()', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead(), {{attr = P.Attr(), row_head_columns = 2, head = {P.Row{cell'h'}}, body = {P.Row{P.Cell({}, 'AlignDefault', 1, 3), cell'x'}, P.Row{cell'a', cell'b', cell'c', cell'd'}}}}, P.TableFoot())}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize table {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead(), {{attr = P.Attr(), row_head_columns = 5, head = {}, body = {P.Row{cell\039a\039}}}}, P.TableFoot{P.Row{cell\039f\039, cell\039g\039, cell\039h\039}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead(), {{attr = P.Attr(), row_head_columns = 5, head = {}, body = {P.Row{cell'a'}}}}, P.TableFoot{P.Row{cell'f', cell'g', cell'h'}})}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize table {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead(), {{attr = P.Attr(), row_head_columns = -1, head = {}, body = {P.Row{P.Cell({}, \039AlignDefault\039, 3, 1), cell\039b\039}, P.Row{cell\039c\039, cell\039d\039}, P.Row{cell\039e\039, cell\039f\039}}}}, P.TableFoot()', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead(), {{attr = P.Attr(), row_head_columns = -1, head = {}, body = {P.Row{P.Cell({}, 'AlignDefault', 3, 1), cell'b'}, P.Row{cell'c', cell'd'}, P.Row{cell'e', cell'f'}}}}, P.TableFoot())}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize table {}, P.TableHead{P.Row{cell\039a\039}}, {{attr = P.Attr(), row_head_columns = 1, head = {}, body = {P.Row{cell\039b\039}}}}, P.TableFoot{P.Row{cell\039c\039}}', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}), {}, P.TableHead{P.Row{cell'a'}}, {{attr = P.Attr(), row_head_columns = 1, head = {}, body = {P.Row{cell'b'}}}}, P.TableFoot{P.Row{cell'c'}})}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize table {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{cell\039a\039, P.Cell({}, \039AlignDefault\039, 2, 1), cell\039c\039}, P.Row{P.Cell({}, \039AlignDefault\039, 1, 3)}}, {}, P.TableFoot()', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{cell'a', P.Cell({}, 'AlignDefault', 2, 1), cell'c'}, P.Row{P.Cell({}, 'AlignDefault', 1, 3)}}, {}, P.TableFoot())}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize table {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{}}, {{attr = P.Attr(), row_head_columns = 1, head = {}, body = {P.Row{P.Cell({}, \039AlignDefault\039, 2, 2), cell\039b\039}, P.Row{cell\039c\039, cell\039d\039, cell\039e\039}}}}, P.TableFoot()', function() return P.Pandoc{P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain{t'a', t'b'}}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignLeft, 0.5}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{}}, {{attr = P.Attr(), row_head_columns = 1, head = {}, body = {P.Row{P.Cell({}, 'AlignDefault', 2, 2), cell'b'}, P.Row{cell'c', cell'd', cell'e'}}}}, P.TableFoot())}:normalize() end)
  probe('normalize meta', function() return P.Pandoc({}, {m = P.MetaInlines{t'a', t'b'}, l = P.MetaList{P.MetaBlocks{P.Para{t'c', t'd'}}}}):normalize() end)
  probe('normalize keeps original', function() local d = P.Pandoc{P.Para{t'a', t'b'}} local n = d:normalize() return d, n end)
  probe('normalize no self', function() return P.Pandoc.normalize() end)
  probe('normalize block', function() return P.Pandoc.normalize(P.Para{}) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter object-pairs empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('pairs Str', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Str'a') do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Emph', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Emph{'a'}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Code', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Code('c')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Link', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Link('a', 'u')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Image', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Image('a', 's')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Cite', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Cite('a', {P.Citation('k', 'NormalCitation')})) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Math', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Math('InlineMath', 'x')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Note', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Note{P.Para'x'}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Quoted', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'a')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs RawInline', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.RawInline('html', 'x')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Span', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Span('a')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Space', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Space()) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Para', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Para'a') do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Header', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Header(1, 'a')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs CodeBlock', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.CodeBlock('x')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Div', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Div{}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs BulletList', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.BulletList{}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs OrderedList', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.OrderedList{}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs DefinitionList', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.DefinitionList{}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Table', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Table(P.Caption(), {}, P.TableHead(), {}, P.TableFoot())) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Figure', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Figure{}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs LineBlock', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.LineBlock{}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs RawBlock', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.RawBlock('html', 'x')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs HorizontalRule', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.HorizontalRule()) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs BlockQuote', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.BlockQuote{}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Attr', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Attr('i', {'c'}, {k='v'})) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Citation', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Citation('k', 'NormalCitation')) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs ListAttributes', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.ListAttributes()) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Cell', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Cell{P.Plain'x'}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Row', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Row{P.Cell{}}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs TableHead', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.TableHead()) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs TableFoot', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.TableFoot()) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Caption', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Caption()) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Pandoc', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Pandoc{}) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Version', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.types.Version'1.2') do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs AttributeList', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Attr('', {}, {{'a', '1'}, {'b', '2'}}).attributes) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs changed Str', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs((function() local s = P.Str'a' s.text = 'b' return s end)()) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs Caption with short', function() local keys = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Caption({P.Plain'x'}, {P.Str'y'})) do keys[#keys + 1] = tostring(k) .. ':' .. type(v) end return table.concat(keys, ' ') end)
  probe('pairs missing utils function', function() return #P.utils.citeproc end)
  probe('state copy', function() PANDOC_STATE.resource_path:insert('new') return table.concat(PANDOC_STATE.resource_path, '|') end)
  probe('state headers copy', function() local h = PANDOC_STATE.request_headers h[1][1] = 'X' return PANDOC_STATE.request_headers[1][1] end)
  probe('state equal lists', function() return PANDOC_STATE.resource_path == PANDOC_STATE.resource_path, rawequal(PANDOC_STATE.resource_path, PANDOC_STATE.resource_path) end)
  probe('state unknown key', function() return PANDOC_STATE.nothing end)
  probe('state set', function() PANDOC_STATE.trace = true return PANDOC_STATE.trace, type(PANDOC_STATE), getmetatable(PANDOC_STATE).__name end)
  probe('state pairs', function() local n = 0 for _ in pairs(PANDOC_STATE) do n = n + 1 end return n end)
  probe('attribute index math.mininteger \039z\039', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[math.mininteger] = 'z' return x end)
  probe('attribute index math.mininteger {\039q\039,\039z\039}', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[math.mininteger] = {'q','z'} return x end)
  probe('attribute index math.mininteger nil', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[math.mininteger] = nil return x end)
  probe('attribute index 0 \039z\039', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[0] = 'z' return x end)
  probe('attribute index 0 {\039q\039,\039z\039}', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[0] = {'q','z'} return x end)
  probe('attribute index 0 nil', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[0] = nil return x end)
  probe('attribute index -1 \039z\039', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[-1] = 'z' return x end)
  probe('attribute index -1 {\039q\039,\039z\039}', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[-1] = {'q','z'} return x end)
  probe('attribute index -1 nil', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[-1] = nil return x end)
  probe('attribute index 1 \039z\039', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[1] = 'z' return x end)
  probe('attribute index 1 {\039q\039,\039z\039}', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[1] = {'q','z'} return x end)
  probe('attribute index 1 nil', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[1] = nil return x end)
  probe('attribute index 2 \039z\039', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[2] = 'z' return x end)
  probe('attribute index 2 {\039q\039,\039z\039}', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[2] = {'q','z'} return x end)
  probe('attribute index 2 nil', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[2] = nil return x end)
  probe('attribute index 3 \039z\039', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[3] = 'z' return x end)
  probe('attribute index 3 {\039q\039,\039z\039}', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[3] = {'q','z'} return x end)
  probe('attribute index 3 nil', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[3] = nil return x end)
  probe('attribute index math.maxinteger \039z\039', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[math.maxinteger] = 'z' return x end)
  probe('attribute index math.maxinteger {\039q\039,\039z\039}', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[math.maxinteger] = {'q','z'} return x end)
  probe('attribute index math.maxinteger nil', function() local x = P.AttributeList{{'a','b'},{'c','d'}} x[math.maxinteger] = nil return x end)
  probe('integer (3)', function() return P.Header('(3)', 'h') end)
  probe('integer - 3', function() return P.Header('- 3', 'h') end)
  probe('integer ((3))', function() return P.Header('((3))', 'h') end)
  probe('integer ( 3 )', function() return P.Header('( 3 )', 'h') end)
  probe('integer (- 3)', function() return P.Header('(- 3)', 'h') end)
  probe('integer -(3)', function() return P.Header('-(3)', 'h') end)
  probe('integer (3', function() return P.Header('(3', 'h') end)
  probe('integer 3)', function() return P.Header('3)', 'h') end)
  probe('integer  -  3 ', function() return P.Header(' -  3 ', 'h') end)
  probe('integer ()', function() return P.Header('()', 'h') end)
  probe('integer (0x10)', function() return P.Header('(0x10)', 'h') end)
  probe('integer --3', function() return P.Header('--3', 'h') end)
  probe('integer -\0093', function() return P.Header('-\0093', 'h') end)
  probe('integer (-3)', function() return P.Header('(-3)', 'h') end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter object-errors empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('call Str', function() local v = P.Str'a' return v() end)
  probe('concat Str', function() local v = P.Str'a' return v .. 'x' end)
  probe('concat left Str', function() local v = P.Str'a' return 'x' .. v end)
  probe('length Str', function() local v = P.Str'a' return #v end)
  probe('less Str', function() local v = P.Str'a' return v < v end)
  probe('less equal Str', function() local v = P.Str'a' return v <= v end)
  probe('add Str', function() local v = P.Str'a' return v + 1 end)
  probe('minus Str', function() local v = P.Str'a' return -v end)

  probe('getmetatable string', function() return getmetatable('x').__index == string end)
  probe('getmetatable list', function() return getmetatable(P.List{}) == P.List end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter path empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('directory \039\039', function() return P.path.directory('') end)
  probe('directory \039.\039', function() return P.path.directory('.') end)
  probe('directory \039..\039', function() return P.path.directory('..') end)
  probe('directory \039/\039', function() return P.path.directory('/') end)

  probe('directory \039///\039', function() return P.path.directory('///') end)
  probe('directory \039a\039', function() return P.path.directory('a') end)

  probe('directory none', function() return P.path.directory() end)
  probe('split_search_path none', function() return P.path.split_search_path() end)
  probe('module names', function() local n = {} for k in pairs(P.path) do n[#n + 1] = k end table.sort(n) return table.concat(n, ' ') end)
  probe('require', function() return require('pandoc.path') == P.path end)
  probe('treat strings', function() P.path.treat_strings_as_paths() return ('a' / 'b') + 'c', ('x.y'):split_extension(), ('/a/b'):directory(), ('a' + '.md') end)
  probe('treat strings error', function() P.path.treat_strings_as_paths() return 'a' / {} end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter text empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

  probe('toencoding \039latin1\039', function() local r = P.text.toencoding('aé€', 'latin1') return (r:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) end)
