  probe('toencoding \039ASCII\039', function() local r = P.text.toencoding('aé€', 'ASCII') return (r:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) end)
  probe('toencoding \039nonsense\039', function() local r = P.text.toencoding('aé€', 'nonsense') return (r:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) end)
  probe('toencoding \039UTF-8//IGNORE\039', function() local r = P.text.toencoding('aé€', 'UTF-8//IGNORE') return (r:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) end)
  probe('toencoding \039utf-16be\039', function() local r = P.text.toencoding('aé€', 'utf-16be') return (r:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) end)
  probe('toencoding nil', function() local r = P.text.toencoding('aé€', nil) return (r:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) end)
  probe('toencoding 5', function() local r = P.text.toencoding('aé€', 5) return (r:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) end)
  probe('toencoding latin \039latin1\039', function() local r = P.text.toencoding('aé', 'latin1') return (r:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) end)
  probe('toencoding latin \039ASCII\039', function() local r = P.text.toencoding('aé', 'ASCII') return (r:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) end)
  probe('toencoding latin \039UTF-16LE\039', function() local r = P.text.toencoding('aé', 'UTF-16LE') return (r:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) end)
  probe('fromencoding \039\092255\092254\039, \039UTF-8\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('\255\254', 'UTF-8') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039a\0920\039, \039UTF-16LE\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('a\0', 'UTF-16LE') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039\0920a\039, \039UTF-16\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('\0a', 'UTF-16') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039a\092195\092169\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('a\195\169') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039a\092255b\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('a\255b') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039a\092195b\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('a\195b') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039\092233\039, \039latin1\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('\233', 'latin1') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039\092233\039, \039ASCII\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('\233', 'ASCII') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039a\039, \039nonsense\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('a', 'nonsense') end)
  probe('fromencoding 12', function() return P.text.fromencoding(12) end)
  probe('fromencoding ', function() return P.text.fromencoding() end)
  probe('fromencoding {}', function() return P.text.fromencoding({}) end)
  probe('fromencoding \039a\039, 5', function() return P.text.fromencoding('a', 5) end)
  probe('fromencoding \039\0920\0920\0920a\039, \039UTF-32\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('\0\0\0a', 'UTF-32') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039a\0920\0920\0920\039, \039UTF-32LE\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('a\0\0\0', 'UTF-32LE') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039\0920\092216\039, \039UTF-16LE\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('\0\216', 'UTF-16LE') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039a\039, \039UTF-16LE\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('a', 'UTF-16LE') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039\0920\0920\09217\0920\039, \039UTF-32\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('\0\0\17\0', 'UTF-32') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039a\092195\092169\039, \039utf8\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('a\195\169', 'utf8') end)
  probe('fromencoding \039\092240\092159\092152\092128x\039, \039UTF-8\039', function() return P.text.fromencoding('\240\159\152\128x', 'UTF-8') end)
  probe('text module names', function() local n = {} for k in pairs(P.text) do n[#n + 1] = k end table.sort(n) return table.concat(n, ' ') end)
  probe('require text', function() return require('pandoc.text') == P.text, require('text') == P.text end)
  probe('len none', function() return P.text.len() end)
  probe('upper table', function() return P.text.upper({}) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter json empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('encode nil', function() return P.json.encode(nil) end)
  probe('encode ', function() return P.json.encode() end)
  probe('encode true', function() return P.json.encode(true) end)
  probe('encode false', function() return P.json.encode(false) end)
  probe('encode 42', function() return P.json.encode(42) end)
  probe('encode -7', function() return P.json.encode(-7) end)
  probe('encode 0', function() return P.json.encode(0) end)
  probe('encode -0.0', function() return P.json.encode(-0.0) end)
  probe('encode 1.5', function() return P.json.encode(1.5) end)
  probe('encode 3.0', function() return P.json.encode(3.0) end)
  probe('encode -2.5', function() return P.json.encode(-2.5) end)
  probe('encode 1e300', function() return P.json.encode(1e300) end)
  probe('encode 1e-7', function() return P.json.encode(1e-7) end)
  probe('encode 1e-6', function() return P.json.encode(1e-6) end)
  probe('encode 0.1', function() return P.json.encode(0.1) end)
  probe('encode 1/3', function() return P.json.encode(1/3) end)
  probe('encode 1e21', function() return P.json.encode(1e21) end)
  probe('encode 1e7', function() return P.json.encode(1e7) end)
  probe('encode 1e8', function() return P.json.encode(1e8) end)
  probe('encode 12345678.5', function() return P.json.encode(12345678.5) end)
  probe('encode 1234567.5', function() return P.json.encode(1234567.5) end)
  probe('encode 123.456', function() return P.json.encode(123.456) end)
  probe('encode 0.000123', function() return P.json.encode(0.000123) end)
  probe('encode math.maxinteger', function() return P.json.encode(math.maxinteger) end)
  probe('encode math.mininteger', function() return P.json.encode(math.mininteger) end)
  probe('encode 2^53', function() return P.json.encode(2^53) end)
  probe('encode 2^53 + 1', function() return P.json.encode(2^53 + 1) end)
  probe('encode 1/0', function() return P.json.encode(1/0) end)
  probe('encode -1/0', function() return P.json.encode(-1/0) end)
  probe('encode 0/0', function() return P.json.encode(0/0) end)
  probe('encode 5e-324', function() return P.json.encode(5e-324) end)
  probe('encode \039a"b\092\092c\092n\092t\0921\0928\09212\09213\09231/<>&\092127\039', function() return P.json.encode('a"b\\c\n\t\1\8\12\13\31/<>&\127') end)
  probe('encode \039\092195\092169\092226\092130\092172\092240\092159\092152\092128\092226\092128\092168\039', function() return P.json.encode('\195\169\226\130\172\240\159\152\128\226\128\168') end)
  probe('encode \039\092255\039', function() return P.json.encode('\255') end)
  probe('encode \039\039', function() return P.json.encode('') end)
  probe('encode {}', function() return P.json.encode({}) end)
  probe('encode {1, \039a\039, true}', function() return P.json.encode({1, 'a', true}) end)
  probe('encode {1, nil, 3}', function() return P.json.encode({1, nil, 3}) end)
  probe('encode {b = 1, a = 2, c = {d = 3}}', function() return P.json.encode({b = 1, a = 2, c = {d = 3}}) end)
  probe('encode {1, 2, x = 3}', function() return P.json.encode({1, 2, x = 3}) end)
  probe('encode {[2] = 1, [3] = 2}', function() return P.json.encode({[2] = 1, [3] = 2}) end)
  probe('encode {[1.5] = 1}', function() return P.json.encode({[1.5] = 1}) end)
  probe('encode {[true] = 1}', function() return P.json.encode({[true] = 1}) end)
  probe('encode {[{}] = 1}', function() return P.json.encode({[{}] = 1}) end)
  probe('encode {[\039b\039] = 1, [2] = 2}', function() return P.json.encode({['b'] = 1, [2] = 2}) end)
  probe('encode {[\039B\039] = 1, [\039a\039] = 2, [\039\195\169\039] = 3, [\039Z\039] = 4}', function() return P.json.encode({['B'] = 1, ['a'] = 2, ['é'] = 3, ['Z'] = 4}) end)
  probe('encode P.json.null', function() return P.json.encode(P.json.null) end)
  probe('encode {1, P.json.null}', function() return P.json.encode({1, P.json.null}) end)
  probe('encode {a = P.json.null}', function() return P.json.encode({a = P.json.null}) end)
  probe('encode P.Str\039a\039', function() return P.json.encode(P.Str'a') end)
  probe('encode P.Para{\039a\039}', function() return P.json.encode(P.Para{'a'}) end)
  probe('encode P.Inlines{\039a b\039}', function() return P.json.encode(P.Inlines{'a b'}) end)
  probe('encode P.Blocks{P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.json.encode(P.Blocks{P.Para'x'}) end)
  probe('encode P.Pandoc({P.Para\039x\039}, {a = \039b\039, n = 1, l = {true, \039x\039}})', function() return P.json.encode(P.Pandoc({P.Para'x'}, {a = 'b', n = 1, l = {true, 'x'}})) end)
  probe('encode P.Attr(\039i\039, {\039c\039}, {k = \039v\039})', function() return P.json.encode(P.Attr('i', {'c'}, {k = 'v'})) end)
  probe('encode P.Meta{a = \039b\039}', function() return P.json.encode(P.Meta{a = 'b'}) end)
  probe('encode P.List{1, 2}', function() return P.json.encode(P.List{1, 2}) end)
  probe('encode P.types.Version\0391.2\039', function() return P.json.encode(P.types.Version'1.2') end)
  probe('encode print', function() return P.json.encode(print) end)
  probe('encode coroutine.create(print)', function() return P.json.encode(coroutine.create(print)) end)
  probe('encode setmetatable({}, {__tojson = function() return \039"X"\039 end})', function() return P.json.encode(setmetatable({}, {__tojson = function() return '"X"' end})) end)
  probe('encode {setmetatable({}, {__tojson = function() return \039"X"\039 end})}', function() return P.json.encode({setmetatable({}, {__tojson = function() return '"X"' end})}) end)
  probe('encode setmetatable({}, {__tojson = function() return 5 end})', function() return P.json.encode(setmetatable({}, {__tojson = function() return 5 end})) end)
  probe('encode setmetatable({}, {__tojson = function() error(\039boom\039) end})', function() return P.json.encode(setmetatable({}, {__tojson = function() error('boom') end})) end)
  probe('encode P.Citation(\039k\039, \039NormalCitation\039)', function() return P.json.encode(P.Citation('k', 'NormalCitation')) end)
  probe('encode P.Caption()', function() return P.json.encode(P.Caption()) end)
  probe('encode P.Cell{}', function() return P.json.encode(P.Cell{}) end)
  probe('encode P.Row{}', function() return P.json.encode(P.Row{}) end)
  probe('encode P.TableHead()', function() return P.json.encode(P.TableHead()) end)
  probe('encode P.TableFoot()', function() return P.json.encode(P.TableFoot()) end)
  probe('encode P.ListAttributes()', function() return P.json.encode(P.ListAttributes()) end)
  probe('encode P.Attr().attributes', function() return P.json.encode(P.Attr().attributes) end)
  probe('encode P.Table(P.Caption(), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignRight, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead(), {}, P.TableFoot())', function() return P.json.encode(P.Table(P.Caption(), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignRight, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead(), {}, P.TableFoot())) end)
  probe('encode P.Image(\039a\039, \039s\039, \039t\039)', function() return P.json.encode(P.Image('a', 's', 't')) end)
  probe('encode P.Math(\039InlineMath\039, \039x\039)', function() return P.json.encode(P.Math('InlineMath', 'x')) end)
  probe('encode P.Header(2, \039h\039, P.Attr(\039i\039))', function() return P.json.encode(P.Header(2, 'h', P.Attr('i'))) end)
  probe('encode P.OrderedList({P.Plain\039a\039}, P.ListAttributes(3, \039LowerRoman\039, \039Period\039))', function() return P.json.encode(P.OrderedList({P.Plain'a'}, P.ListAttributes(3, 'LowerRoman', 'Period'))) end)
  probe('encode (function() local s = P.Str\039a\039 s.text = \039changed\039 return s end)()', function() return P.json.encode((function() local s = P.Str'a' s.text = 'changed' return s end)()) end)
  probe('encode {P.Str\039a\039, 1}', function() return P.json.encode({P.Str'a', 1}) end)
  probe('encode {x = P.Para\039p\039}', function() return P.json.encode({x = P.Para'p'}) end)
  probe('encode P.MetaInlines{\039a\039}', function() return P.json.encode(P.MetaInlines{'a'}) end)
  probe('encode P.MetaBool(true)', function() return P.json.encode(P.MetaBool(true)) end)
  probe('decode \039{"a":1,"b":[1,2.5,null,true],"c":{}}\039', function() return P.json.decode('{"a":1,"b":[1,2.5,null,true],"c":{}}') end)
  probe('decode \039{"t":"Str","c":"a"}\039', function() return P.json.decode('{"t":"Str","c":"a"}') end)
  probe('decode \039{"t":"Str","c":"a"}\039, false', function() return P.json.decode('{"t":"Str","c":"a"}', false) end)
  probe('decode \039{"t":"Str","c":"a"}\039, true', function() return P.json.decode('{"t":"Str","c":"a"}', true) end)
  probe('decode \039{"t":"Str","c":"a"}\039, nil', function() return P.json.decode('{"t":"Str","c":"a"}', nil) end)
  probe('decode \039{"t":"Str","c":"a"}\039, 0', function() return P.json.decode('{"t":"Str","c":"a"}', 0) end)
  probe('decode \039[{"t":"Str","c":"a"}]\039', function() return P.json.decode('[{"t":"Str","c":"a"}]') end)
  probe('decode \039[{"t":"Para","c":[]}]\039', function() return P.json.decode('[{"t":"Para","c":[]}]') end)
  probe('decode \039[]\039', function() return P.json.decode('[]') end)
  probe('decode \039[]\039, false', function() return P.json.decode('[]', false) end)
  probe('decode \039{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{},"blocks":[]}\039', function() return P.json.decode('{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{},"blocks":[]}') end)
  probe('decode \039{\039', function() return P.json.decode('{') end)
  probe('decode \039[1,]\039', function() return P.json.decode('[1,]') end)
  probe('decode \03912\039', function() return P.json.decode('12') end)
  probe('decode \0391.0\039', function() return P.json.decode('1.0') end)
  probe('decode \0391e2\039', function() return P.json.decode('1e2') end)
  probe('decode \039-0\039', function() return P.json.decode('-0') end)
  probe('decode \039123456789012345678901234567890\039', function() return P.json.decode('123456789012345678901234567890') end)
  probe('decode \0391e400\039', function() return P.json.decode('1e400') end)
  probe('decode \03901\039', function() return P.json.decode('01') end)
  probe('decode \039.5\039', function() return P.json.decode('.5') end)
  probe('decode \0391.\039', function() return P.json.decode('1.') end)
  probe('decode \039"a\092\092u00e9\092\092ud83d\092\092ude00"\039', function() return P.json.decode('"a\\u00e9\\ud83d\\ude00"') end)
  probe('decode \039"\092\092ud83d"\039', function() return P.json.decode('"\\ud83d"') end)
  probe('decode \039"\092\092ud83dx"\039', function() return P.json.decode('"\\ud83dx"') end)
  probe('decode \039"\092\092x"\039', function() return P.json.decode('"\\x"') end)
  probe('decode \039\039', function() return P.json.decode('') end)
  probe('decode \039  \039', function() return P.json.decode('  ') end)
  probe('decode ', function() return P.json.decode() end)
  probe('decode {}', function() return P.json.decode({}) end)
  probe('decode 12', function() return P.json.decode(12) end)
  probe('decode \0391 2\039', function() return P.json.decode('1 2') end)
  probe('decode \039  [1]  \039', function() return P.json.decode('  [1]  ') end)
  probe('decode \039{"a":1,"a":2}\039', function() return P.json.decode('{"a":1,"a":2}') end)
  probe('decode \039null\039', function() return P.json.decode('null') end)
  probe('decode \039true\039', function() return P.json.decode('true') end)
  probe('decode \039"s"\039', function() return P.json.decode('"s"') end)
  probe('decode \039[[[]]]\039', function() return P.json.decode('[[[]]]') end)
  probe('decode \039{"t":"Str"}\039', function() return P.json.decode('{"t":"Str"}') end)
  probe('decode \039{"t":"Str","c":"a","x":1}\039', function() return P.json.decode('{"t":"Str","c":"a","x":1}') end)
  probe('decode \039{"t":"Space"}\039', function() return P.json.decode('{"t":"Space"}') end)
  probe('decode \039[{"t":"Space"}, {"t":"Para","c":[]}]\039', function() return P.json.decode('[{"t":"Space"}, {"t":"Para","c":[]}]') end)
  probe('decode \039{"t":"MetaString","c":"x"}\039', function() return P.json.decode('{"t":"MetaString","c":"x"}') end)
  probe('decode \039["i",[],[]]\039', function() return P.json.decode('["i",[],[]]') end)
  probe('decode \039"\092t"\039', function() return P.json.decode('"\t"') end)
  probe('decode \039"\092\092/"\039', function() return P.json.decode('"\\/"') end)
  probe('decode \039{"b":1,"a":{"c":[1,{"d":null}]}}\039', function() return P.json.decode('{"b":1,"a":{"c":[1,{"d":null}]}}') end)
  probe('decode \039[1,null,3]\039', function() return P.json.decode('[1,null,3]') end)
  probe('decode \039{"1":"x","2":"y"}\039', function() return P.json.decode('{"1":"x","2":"y"}') end)
  probe('null', function() return type(P.json.null), P.json.null == P.json.null, tostring(P.json.null):gsub('0x%x+', 'ADDR') end)
  probe('decode null identity', function() return P.json.decode('null') == P.json.null, P.json.decode('[null]')[1] == P.json.null end)
  probe('decode list metatable', function() local t = P.json.decode('[1]') return getmetatable(t) == P.List, getmetatable(P.json.decode('{}')) end)
  probe('roundtrip', function() return P.json.encode(P.json.decode('{"x":[1,2,{"y":"z"}],"a":false}')) end)
  probe('tojson Inlines', function() return getmetatable(P.Inlines{}).__tojson(P.Inlines{'x y'}) end)
  probe('module names json', function() local n = {} for k in pairs(P.json) do n[#n + 1] = k end table.sort(n) return table.concat(n, ' ') end)
  probe('require json', function() return require('pandoc.json') == P.json end)
  probe('encode deep', function() local t = {} local x = t for i = 1, 100 do x[1] = {} x = x[1] end return #P.json.encode(t) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter system empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('system names', function() local n = {} for k in pairs(P.system) do n[#n + 1] = k end table.sort(n) return table.concat(n, ' ') end)
  probe('system field types', function() return type(P.system.os), type(P.system.arch) end)
  probe('read_file none', function() return P.system.read_file() end)
  probe('read_file table', function() return P.system.read_file({}) end)
  probe('write_file one', function() return P.system.write_file('x.txt') end)
  probe('write_file table', function() return P.system.write_file({}, 'a') end)
  probe('write_file contents table', function() return P.system.write_file('x.txt', {}) end)
  probe('require system', function() return require('pandoc.system') == P.system end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter format empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

'=' .. tostring(P.format.from_path('x.' .. e)) end return table.concat(out, ' ') end)

  probe('from_path \039x.tar.gz\039', function() return P.format.from_path('x.tar.gz') end)
  probe('from_path \039README\039', function() return P.format.from_path('README') end)
  probe('from_path \039x.1.gz\039', function() return P.format.from_path('x.1.gz') end)
  probe('from_path \039x.md \039', function() return P.format.from_path('x.md ') end)
  probe('from_path \039x. md\039', function() return P.format.from_path('x. md') end)
  probe('from_path \039x.md?y\039', function() return P.format.from_path('x.md?y') end)
  probe('from_path \039x.md#a\039', function() return P.format.from_path('x.md#a') end)
  probe('from_path \039https://h/x.html?y=1\039', function() return P.format.from_path('https://h/x.html?y=1') end)
  probe('from_path \039https://h/x.html#f\039', function() return P.format.from_path('https://h/x.html#f') end)
  probe('from_path \039x.LaTeX\039', function() return P.format.from_path('x.LaTeX') end)
  probe('from_path \039x.TXT\039', function() return P.format.from_path('x.TXT') end)
  probe('from_path \039\039', function() return P.format.from_path('') end)
  probe('from_path \039.\039', function() return P.format.from_path('.') end)
  probe('from_path \039a/b/c.rst\039', function() return P.format.from_path('a/b/c.rst') end)
  probe('from_path \039C:\092\092x\092\092y.md\039', function() return P.format.from_path('C:\092x\092y.md') end)
  probe('from_path \039ftp://h/y.tex\039', function() return P.format.from_path('ftp://h/y.tex') end)
  probe('from_path list', function() return P.format.from_path({'x.zzz', 'y.md'}), P.format.from_path({'y.md', 'x.zzz'}), P.format.from_path({'x.zzz'}), P.format.from_path({}) end)
  probe('from_path number', function() return P.format.from_path(5) end)
  probe('from_path none', function() return P.format.from_path() end)
  probe('from_path table bad', function() return P.format.from_path({{}}) end)
  probe('default none', function() return P.format.default_extensions() end)
  probe('require format', function() return require('pandoc.format') == P.format end)
  probe('constructor tables', function() local n = {} for k, v in pairs(P.Inline.constructor) do n[#n + 1] = k .. tostring(v == P[k]) end for k, v in pairs(P.Block.constructor) do n[#n + 1] = k .. tostring(v == P[k]) end table.sort(n) return table.concat(n, ' ') end)
  probe('constructor call', function() return P.Inline.constructor.Str('a'), P.Block.constructor.Para{'x'}, P.utils.type(P.Block) end)
  probe('constructor error', function() return P.Inline.constructor.Str() end)
  probe('Block keys', function() local n = {} for k in pairs(P.Block) do n[#n + 1] = k end return table.concat(n, ' '), getmetatable(P.Block) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter show empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('tostring P.Attr(\039i\039, {\039c\039, \039d\039}, {{\039k\039, \039v\039}, {\039q\039, \039a"b\039}})', function() return tostring(P.Attr('i', {'c', 'd'}, {{'k', 'v'}, {'q', 'a"b'}})) end)
  probe('tostring P.Attr().attributes', function() return tostring(P.Attr().attributes) end)
  probe('tostring P.Attr(\039\039, {}, {{\039x\039, \039y\039}}).attributes', function() return tostring(P.Attr('', {}, {{'x', 'y'}}).attributes) end)
  probe('tostring P.Citation(\039k\039, \039AuthorInText\039, {P.Str\039p\039}, {P.Str\039s\039}, 3, 7)', function() return tostring(P.Citation('k', 'AuthorInText', {P.Str'p'}, {P.Str's'}, 3, 7)) end)
  probe('tostring P.Citation(\039k\039, \039SuppressAuthor\039)', function() return tostring(P.Citation('k', 'SuppressAuthor')) end)
  probe('tostring P.Caption()', function() return tostring(P.Caption()) end)
  probe('tostring P.Caption({P.Para\039x\039})', function() return tostring(P.Caption({P.Para'x'})) end)
  probe('tostring P.Caption({P.Para\039x\039}, {P.Str\039short\039})', function() return tostring(P.Caption({P.Para'x'}, {P.Str'short'})) end)
  probe('tostring P.Cell{P.Plain\039x\039}', function() return tostring(P.Cell{P.Plain'x'}) end)
  probe('tostring P.Cell({P.Plain\039x\039}, \039AlignRight\039, 2, 3, P.Attr(\039c\039))', function() return tostring(P.Cell({P.Plain'x'}, 'AlignRight', 2, 3, P.Attr('c'))) end)
  probe('tostring P.Row{P.Cell{}}', function() return tostring(P.Row{P.Cell{}}) end)
  probe('tostring P.Row({P.Cell{}}, P.Attr(\039r\039))', function() return tostring(P.Row({P.Cell{}}, P.Attr('r'))) end)
  probe('tostring P.TableHead()', function() return tostring(P.TableHead()) end)
  probe('tostring P.TableHead({P.Row{}}, P.Attr(\039h\039))', function() return tostring(P.TableHead({P.Row{}}, P.Attr('h'))) end)
  probe('tostring P.TableFoot()', function() return tostring(P.TableFoot()) end)
  probe('tostring P.TableFoot({P.Row{}}, P.Attr(\039f\039))', function() return tostring(P.TableFoot({P.Row{}}, P.Attr('f'))) end)
  probe('tostring P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain\039c\039}, {P.Str\039s\039}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignCenter, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{P.Cell{}}}, {{attr = P.Attr(\039b\039), row_head_columns = 1, head = {P.Row{}}, body = {P.Row{P.Cell{}, P.Cell{}}}}}, P.TableFoot{P.Row{}}, P.Attr(\039t\039))', function() return tostring(P.Table(P.Caption({P.Plain'c'}, {P.Str's'}), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignCenter, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{P.Cell{}}}, {{attr = P.Attr('b'), row_head_columns = 1, head = {P.Row{}}, body = {P.Row{P.Cell{}, P.Cell{}}}}}, P.TableFoot{P.Row{}}, P.Attr('t'))) end)
  probe('tostring P.Table(P.Caption(), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignCenter, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{P.Cell{}}}, {{attr = P.Attr(\039b\039), row_head_columns = 1, head = {P.Row{}}, body = {P.Row{P.Cell{}, P.Cell{}}}}}, P.TableFoot{P.Row{}}, P.Attr(\039t\039)).bodies[1]', function() return tostring(P.Table(P.Caption(), {{P.AlignLeft, 0.5}, {P.AlignCenter, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{P.Row{P.Cell{}}}, {{attr = P.Attr('b'), row_head_columns = 1, head = {P.Row{}}, body = {P.Row{P.Cell{}, P.Cell{}}}}}, P.TableFoot{P.Row{}}, P.Attr('t')).bodies[1]) end)
  probe('tostring P.Pandoc({P.Para\039x\039}, {a = \039b\039, n = true, f = false, l = {\039x\039, {P.Para\039y\039}}, m = {k = P.MetaInlines{\039i\039}}, e = {}, s = P.MetaString\039str\039, bl = P.MetaBlocks{P.Para\039b\039}})', function() return tostring(P.Pandoc({P.Para'x'}, {a = 'b', n = true, f = false, l = {'x', {P.Para'y'}}, m = {k = P.MetaInlines{'i'}}, e = {}, s = P.MetaString'str', bl = P.MetaBlocks{P.Para'b'}})) end)
  probe('tostring P.Meta{a = \039b\039}', function() return tostring(P.Meta{a = 'b'}) end)
  probe('tostring P.types.Version\0391.2.3\039', function() return tostring(P.types.Version'1.2.3') end)
  probe('tostring P.types.Version{2, 0}', function() return tostring(P.types.Version{2, 0}) end)
  probe('tostring P.ListAttributes(2, \039UpperAlpha\039, \039TwoParens\039)', function() return tostring(P.ListAttributes(2, 'UpperAlpha', 'TwoParens')) end)
  probe('tostring P.Figure({P.Plain\039x\039}, P.Caption({P.Plain\039c\039}), P.Attr(\039fig\039))', function() return tostring(P.Figure({P.Plain'x'}, P.Caption({P.Plain'c'}), P.Attr('fig'))) end)
  probe('tostring P.Image({P.Str\039a\039}, \039src\039, \039title\039, P.Attr(\039img\039))', function() return tostring(P.Image({P.Str'a'}, 'src', 'title', P.Attr('img'))) end)
  probe('tostring P.Cite({P.Str\039c\039}, {P.Citation(\039k\039, \039NormalCitation\039)})', function() return tostring(P.Cite({P.Str'c'}, {P.Citation('k', 'NormalCitation')})) end)
  probe('tostring P.Math(\039DisplayMath\039, \039x^2\039)', function() return tostring(P.Math('DisplayMath', 'x^2')) end)
  probe('tostring P.Quoted(\039SingleQuote\039, {P.Str\039q\039})', function() return tostring(P.Quoted('SingleQuote', {P.Str'q'})) end)
  probe('tostring P.Link({P.Str\039l\039}, \039u\039, \039t\039, P.Attr(\039a\039))', function() return tostring(P.Link({P.Str'l'}, 'u', 't', P.Attr('a'))) end)
  probe('tostring P.OrderedList({{P.Plain\039a\039}}, P.ListAttributes(3, \039LowerRoman\039, \039OneParen\039))', function() return tostring(P.OrderedList({{P.Plain'a'}}, P.ListAttributes(3, 'LowerRoman', 'OneParen'))) end)
  probe('tostring P.DefinitionList{{{P.Str\039t\039}, {{P.Plain\039d\039}}}}', function() return tostring(P.DefinitionList{{{P.Str't'}, {{P.Plain'd'}}}}) end)
  probe('tostring P.LineBlock{{P.Str\039a\039}, {P.Str\039b\039}}', function() return tostring(P.LineBlock{{P.Str'a'}, {P.Str'b'}}) end)
  probe('tostring P.RawBlock(\039tex\039, \039\092\092x\039)', function() return tostring(P.RawBlock('tex', '\\x')) end)
  probe('tostring P.CodeBlock(\039c\092n"q"\039, P.Attr(\039\039, {\039lua\039}))', function() return tostring(P.CodeBlock('c\n"q"', P.Attr('', {'lua'}))) end)
  probe('tostring P.Header(-3, {P.Str\039h\039})', function() return tostring(P.Header(-3, {P.Str'h'})) end)
  probe('tostring P.Str\039\0921\092127 \092195\092169 \092226\092130\092172 \092240\092159\092152\092128\039', function() return tostring(P.Str'\1\127 \195\169 \226\130\172 \240\159\152\128') end)
  probe('tostring P.Str\039tab\092there\039', function() return tostring(P.Str'tab\there') end)
  probe('tostring P.Str\039\092\092back"\039', function() return tostring(P.Str'\\back"') end)
  probe('tostring P.Note{P.Para\039n\039}', function() return tostring(P.Note{P.Para'n'}) end)
  probe('tostring P.Span({P.Str\039s\039}, P.Attr(\039\039, {}, {{\039k\039, \039v\039}}))', function() return tostring(P.Span({P.Str's'}, P.Attr('', {}, {{'k', 'v'}}))) end)
  probe('tostring P.Inlines{P.Str\039a\039, P.Space()}', function() return tostring(P.Inlines{P.Str'a', P.Space()}) end)
  probe('tostring P.Blocks{P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div({}, P.Attr(\039d\039))}', function() return tostring(P.Blocks{P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div({}, P.Attr('d'))}) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter structure empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function doc()
  return {P.Para'intro', H(1,'a', P.Attr('ida')), P.Para'pa', H(2,'b'), H(1,'c', P.Attr('', {'unnumbered'})), H(2, 'd')}
end

local function run(document)
  probe('make_sections doc()', function() return P.structure.make_sections(doc()) end)
  probe('make_sections doc(), {number_sections = true}', function() return P.structure.make_sections(doc(), {number_sections = true}) end)
  probe('make_sections doc(), {number_sections = true, base_level = 2}', function() return P.structure.make_sections(doc(), {number_sections = true, base_level = 2}) end)
  probe('make_sections P.Pandoc(doc())', function() return P.structure.make_sections(P.Pandoc(doc())) end)
  probe('make_sections ', function() return P.structure.make_sections() end)
  probe('make_sections doc(), 5', function() return P.structure.make_sections(doc(), 5) end)
  probe('make_sections doc(), \039x\039', function() return P.structure.make_sections(doc(), 'x') end)
  probe('make_sections doc(), {base_level = \039x\039}', function() return P.structure.make_sections(doc(), {base_level = 'x'}) end)
  probe('make_sections doc(), {base_level = 1.5}', function() return P.structure.make_sections(doc(), {base_level = 1.5}) end)
  probe('make_sections P.Para\039x\039', function() return P.structure.make_sections(P.Para'x') end)
  probe('make_sections {}', function() return P.structure.make_sections({}) end)
  probe('make_sections doc(), {number_sections = 1}', function() return P.structure.make_sections(doc(), {number_sections = 1}) end)
  probe('make_sections doc(), nil', function() return P.structure.make_sections(doc(), nil) end)
  probe('make_sections {H(1, \039x\039)}, {base_level = 3, number_sections = true}', function() return P.structure.make_sections({H(1, 'x')}, {base_level = 3, number_sections = true}) end)
  probe('slide_level doc()', function() return P.structure.slide_level(doc()) end)
  probe('slide_level {H(1,\039a\039), H(2,\039b\039), P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level({H(1,'a'), H(2,'b'), P.Para'x'}) end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level({P.Para'x'}) end)
  probe('slide_level {H(1,\039a\039), P.HorizontalRule(), H(3, \039x\039), P.Para\039p\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level({H(1,'a'), P.HorizontalRule(), H(3, 'x'), P.Para'p'}) end)
  probe('slide_level P.Pandoc{H(2,\039a\039), P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level(P.Pandoc{H(2,'a'), P.Para'x'}) end)
  probe('slide_level {H(2, \039a\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level({H(2, 'a')}) end)
  probe('slide_level {}', function() return P.structure.slide_level({}) end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Div{H(1, \039a\039), P.Para\039x\039}, H(3, \039b\039), P.Para\039y\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level({P.Div{H(1, 'a'), P.Para'x'}, H(3, 'b'), P.Para'y'}) end)
  probe('slide_level {H(4, \039a\039), P.Div{}, H(2, \039b\039), H(1, \039c\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level({H(4, 'a'), P.Div{}, H(2, 'b'), H(1, 'c')}) end)
  probe('slide_level {H(9, \039a\039), P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level({H(9, 'a'), P.Para'x'}) end)
  probe('slide_level {H(0, \039a\039), P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level({H(0, 'a'), P.Para'x'}) end)
  probe('slide_level ', function() return P.structure.slide_level() end)
  probe('slide_level 5', function() return P.structure.slide_level(5) end)
  probe('unique identifiers', function() local used, out = {}, {} for _, t in ipairs{'Hello World', 'Hello World', '', '123 abc', 'Ünïcödé', 'a.b_c-d e', '  ', '!!!', 'Hello World'} do local id = P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str(t)}, used) used[id] = true out[#out + 1] = id end return table.concat(out, ' ') end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Str\039Hello\039, P.Space(), P.Emph{P.Str\039World\039}}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str'Hello', P.Space(), P.Emph{P.Str'World'}}) end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Str\039\195\156n\195\175\039}, {}, {\039ascii_identifiers\039}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str'Ünï'}, {}, {'ascii_identifiers'}) end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Str\039A B\039}, {}, {\039gfm_auto_identifiers\039}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str'A B'}, {}, {'gfm_auto_identifiers'}) end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Str\039A B\039}, {}, {\039gfm_auto_identifiers\039, \039ascii_identifiers\039}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str'A B'}, {}, {'gfm_auto_identifiers', 'ascii_identifiers'}) end)
  probe('unique_identifier ', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier() end)
  probe('unique_identifier \039some text\039', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier('some text') end)
  probe('unique_identifier P.Str\039x\039', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier(P.Str'x') end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Str\039x\039}, {x = true, [\039x-1\039] = true}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str'x'}, {x = true, ['x-1'] = true}) end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Str\039x\039}, {x = false}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str'x'}, {x = false}) end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Str\039x\039}, {\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str'x'}, {'x'}) end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Str\039x\039}, nil, {\039nonsense\039}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str'x'}, nil, {'nonsense'}) end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Str\039x\039}, 5', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str'x'}, 5) end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Str\0393. \196\140as\039}, {}, {}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Str'3. Čas'}, {}, {}) end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Code(\039c d\039), P.Math(\039InlineMath\039, \039x\039)}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Code('c d'), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x')}) end)
  probe('unique_identifier {P.Note{P.Para\039n\039}, P.Str\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.unique_identifier({P.Note{P.Para'n'}, P.Str'x'}) end)
  probe('structure names', function() local n = {} for k in pairs(P.structure) do n[#n + 1] = k end table.sort(n) return table.concat(n, ' ') end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

local function run(document)
  probe('PANDOC_STATE.output_file', function() return PANDOC_STATE.output_file end)
  probe('PANDOC_STATE.source_url', function() return PANDOC_STATE.source_url end)
  probe('PANDOC_STATE.user_data_dir', function() return PANDOC_STATE.user_data_dir end)

  probe('PANDOC_STATE.nokey', function() return PANDOC_STATE.nokey end)
  probe('PANDOC_STATE.Output_file', function() return PANDOC_STATE.Output_file end)
  probe('PANDOC_STATE.input', function() return PANDOC_STATE.input end)
  probe('state key 1', function() return PANDOC_STATE[1] end)
  probe('state key true', function() return PANDOC_STATE[true] end)
  probe('state output test', function() if PANDOC_STATE.output_file then return 'file' end return 'stdout' end)
end

@@@ filter json-empty-lists empty small

local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end

  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.

  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('encode P.List{}', function() return P.json.encode(P.List{}) end)
  probe('encode P.Inlines{}', function() return P.json.encode(P.Inlines{}) end)
  probe('encode P.Blocks{}', function() return P.json.encode(P.Blocks{}) end)
  probe('encode {}', function() return P.json.encode({}) end)
  probe('encode setmetatable({}, {})', function() return P.json.encode(setmetatable({}, {})) end)
  probe('encode setmetatable({}, {__name = \039List\039})', function() return P.json.encode(setmetatable({}, {__name = 'List'})) end)
  probe('encode setmetatable({}, P.List)', function() return P.json.encode(setmetatable({}, P.List)) end)
  probe('encode {a = P.List{}}', function() return P.json.encode({a = P.List{}}) end)
  probe('encode P.List{P.List{}}', function() return P.json.encode(P.List{P.List{}}) end)
  probe('encode {P.List{}, {}}', function() return P.json.encode({P.List{}, {}}) end)
  probe('encode P.Attr().classes', function() return P.json.encode(P.Attr().classes) end)
  probe('encode P.Attr().attributes', function() return P.json.encode(P.Attr().attributes) end)
  probe('encode P.AttributeList{}', function() return P.json.encode(P.AttributeList{}) end)
  probe('encode P.MetaList{}', function() return P.json.encode(P.MetaList{}) end)
  probe('encode P.Meta{}', function() return P.json.encode(P.Meta{}) end)
  probe('encode P.Div{}.content', function() return P.json.encode(P.Div{}.content) end)
  probe('encode P.Para{}.content', function() return P.json.encode(P.Para{}.content) end)
  probe('encode P.Cell{}.contents', function() return P.json.encode(P.Cell{}.contents) end)
  probe('encode P.Table(P.Caption(), {}, P.TableHead(), {}, P.TableFoot()).bodies', function() return P.json.encode(P.Table(P.Caption(), {}, P.TableHead(), {}, P.TableFoot()).bodies) end)
  probe('encode P.json.decode(\039[]\039)', function() return P.json.encode(P.json.decode('[]')) end)
  probe('encode P.json.decode(\039{"a":[]}\039)', function() return P.json.encode(P.json.decode('{"a":[]}')) end)
  probe('encode P.json.decode(\039[[],{}]\039)', function() return P.json.encode(P.json.decode('[[],{}]')) end)
  probe('encode P.json.decode(\039{"a":{}}\039)', function() return P.json.encode(P.json.decode('{"a":{}}')) end)
  probe('encode P.json.decode(\039{"a":[[]]}\039)', function() return P.json.encode(P.json.decode('{"a":[[]]}')) end)
  probe('encode P.Pandoc{}', function() return P.json.encode(P.Pandoc{}) end)
  probe('encode P.List{1}:filter(function() return false end)', function() return P.json.encode(P.List{1}:filter(function() return false end)) end)
  probe('encode P.List{1}:map(function(x) return x end)', function() return P.json.encode(P.List{1}:map(function(x) return x end)) end)
  probe('encode P.Inlines{}:clone()', function() return P.json.encode(P.Inlines{}:clone()) end)
  probe('encode pandoc.List{}:clone()', function() return P.json.encode(pandoc.List{}:clone()) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter json-numbers empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter text-bom empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('fromencoding \039\092255\092254a\0920\039 UTF-16', function() local s = P.text.fromencoding('\255\254a\0', 'UTF-16') return (s:gsub('.', function(c) return c:byte() .. ' ' end)) end)
  probe('fromencoding \039\092254\092255\0920a\039 UTF-16', function() local s = P.text.fromencoding('\254\255\0a', 'UTF-16') return (s:gsub('.', function(c) return c:byte() .. ' ' end)) end)
  probe('fromencoding \039\092255\092254\0920\0920a\0920\0920\0920\039 UTF-16', function() local s = P.text.fromencoding('\255\254\0\0a\0\0\0', 'UTF-16') return (s:gsub('.', function(c) return c:byte() .. ' ' end)) end)

  probe('toencoding utf16', function() return (P.text.toencoding('a\226\128\147', 'utf16'):gsub('.', function(c) return c:byte() .. ' ' end)) end)
  probe('toencoding UTF16LE//IGNORE', function() return (P.text.toencoding('a\226\128\147', 'UTF16LE//IGNORE'):gsub('.', function(c) return c:byte() .. ' ' end)) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter slide-level empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('slide_level {H(2, \039a\039), P.Div{H(1, \039b\039), P.Para\039c\039}}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(2, 'a'), P.Div{H(1, 'b'), P.Para'c'}} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(2, \039a\039), P.Para\039x\039, P.Div{H(1, \039b\039), P.Para\039c\039}}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(2, 'a'), P.Para'x', P.Div{H(1, 'b'), P.Para'c'}} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Div{H(1, \039b\039), P.Para\039c\039}}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Div{H(1, 'b'), P.Para'c'}} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(2, \039a\039), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(2, 'a'), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Para'x'} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(3, \039a\039), H(2, \039b\039), P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(3, 'a'), H(2, 'b'), P.Para'x'} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(1, \039a\039), P.Div{}, H(2, \039b\039), P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(1, 'a'), P.Div{}, H(2, 'b'), P.Para'x'} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Div{H(3, \039a\039)}, P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Div{H(3, 'a')}, P.Para'x'} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(2, \039a\039), P.Div{P.Div{H(1, \039b\039), P.Para\039c\039}}}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(2, 'a'), P.Div{P.Div{H(1, 'b'), P.Para'c'}}} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(4, \039a\039), P.Para\039x\039, H(4, \039b\039), P.Div{H(2, \039c\039), P.Para\039y\039}}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(4, 'a'), P.Para'x', H(4, 'b'), P.Div{H(2, 'c'), P.Para'y'}} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(1, \039a\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(1, 'a')} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Para\039x\039, H(1, \039a\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Para'x', H(1, 'a')} end)

  probe('slide_level {P.Div{H(3, \039a\039), P.Para\039x\039}, H(2, \039b\039), P.Div{H(1, \039c\039), P.Para\039y\039}}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Div{H(3, 'a'), P.Para'x'}, H(2, 'b'), P.Div{H(1, 'c'), P.Para'y'}} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Div{H(2, \039a\039), P.Para\039x\039}, H(2, \039b\039), P.Div{H(1, \039c\039), P.Para\039y\039}}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Div{H(2, 'a'), P.Para'x'}, H(2, 'b'), P.Div{H(1, 'c'), P.Para'y'}} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Div{P.Div{H(2, \039a\039), P.Para\039x\039}, H(3, \039b\039), P.Div{H(1, \039c\039), P.Para\039y\039}}}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Div{P.Div{H(2, 'a'), P.Para'x'}, H(3, 'b'), P.Div{H(1, 'c'), P.Para'y'}}} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Div{H(4, \039a\039), P.Para\039x\039}, P.Div{H(5, \039b\039), P.Div{H(1, \039c\039), P.Para\039y\039}}}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Div{H(4, 'a'), P.Para'x'}, P.Div{H(5, 'b'), P.Div{H(1, 'c'), P.Para'y'}}} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(3, \039a\039), P.BlockQuote{H(1, \039q\039), P.Para\039y\039}, H(2, \039b\039), P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(3, 'a'), P.BlockQuote{H(1, 'q'), P.Para'y'}, H(2, 'b'), P.Para'x'} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Para\039x\039, H(3, \039h\039), H(2, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Para'x', H(3, 'h'), H(2, 'h')} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(3, \039h\039), H(4, \039h\039), H(2, \039h\039), P.Div{}, H(5, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(3, 'h'), H(4, 'h'), H(2, 'h'), P.Div{}, H(5, 'h')} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(4, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(4, 'h')} end)

  probe('slide_level {P.HorizontalRule(), H(6, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.HorizontalRule(), H(6, 'h')} end)

  probe('slide_level {}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{} end)

  probe('slide_level {H(6, \039h\039), P.Para\039x\039, H(6, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(6, 'h'), P.Para'x', H(6, 'h')} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(4, \039h\039), H(4, \039h\039), H(3, \039h\039), H(5, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(4, 'h'), H(4, 'h'), H(3, 'h'), H(5, 'h')} end)

  probe('slide_level {H(2, \039h\039), H(1, \039h\039), P.HorizontalRule()}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(2, 'h'), H(1, 'h'), P.HorizontalRule()} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Div{}, H(5, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Div{}, H(5, 'h')} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(6, \039h\039), P.Div{H(5, \039h\039), P.Div{H(2, \039h\039)}, P.Para\039x\039, H(4, \039h\039)}, P.Para\039x\039, H(6, \039h\039), P.Para\039x\039}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(6, 'h'), P.Div{H(5, 'h'), P.Div{H(2, 'h')}, P.Para'x', H(4, 'h')}, P.Para'x', H(6, 'h'), P.Para'x'} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(4, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(4, 'h')} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(1, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(1, 'h')} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Div{H(6, \039h\039), H(3, \039h\039), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Para\039x\039, H(4, \039h\039)}, P.HorizontalRule()}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Div{H(6, 'h'), H(3, 'h'), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Para'x', H(4, 'h')}, P.HorizontalRule()} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(4, \039h\039), H(6, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(4, 'h'), H(6, 'h')} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Div{H(6, \039h\039)}, H(5, \039h\039), H(4, \039h\039), P.HorizontalRule()}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Div{H(6, 'h')}, H(5, 'h'), H(4, 'h'), P.HorizontalRule()} end)
  probe('slide_level {}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{} end)
  probe('slide_level {P.Para\039x\039, H(1, \039h\039), H(4, \039h\039), H(3, \039h\039), H(3, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{P.Para'x', H(1, 'h'), H(4, 'h'), H(3, 'h'), H(3, 'h')} end)
  probe('slide_level {H(6, \039h\039), H(1, \039h\039)}', function() return P.structure.slide_level{H(6, 'h'), H(1, 'h')} end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter from-path-uri empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('from_path \039file:/a.md#x\039', function() return P.format.from_path('file:/a.md#x') end)
  probe('from_path \039file:///a.md#x\039', function() return P.format.from_path('file:///a.md#x') end)
  probe('from_path \039file:a.md?q\039', function() return P.format.from_path('file:a.md?q') end)
  probe('from_path \039https://h/\195\169.md#x\039', function() return P.format.from_path('https://h/\195\169.md#x') end)
  probe('from_path \039https://h/a.md#x\039', function() return P.format.from_path('https://h/a.md#x') end)
  probe('from_path \039https://h/a.md?x=1#y\039', function() return P.format.from_path('https://h/a.md?x=1#y') end)
  probe('from_path \039http://h:80/a.tex\039', function() return P.format.from_path('http://h:80/a.tex') end)
  probe('from_path \039http://h:x/a.tex\039', function() return P.format.from_path('http://h:x/a.tex') end)
  probe('from_path \039http://[::1]/a.rst\039', function() return P.format.from_path('http://[::1]/a.rst') end)

  probe('from_path \039mailto:a.md\039', function() return P.format.from_path('mailto:a.md') end)

@@@ filter changed-chains empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end


local function run(document)
  probe('insert chain 1', function() local e = P.Plain{P.Str'x'} for i = 1, 1 do local d = P.Div{} d.content:insert(e) e = d end return #tostring(e), #P.json.encode(e) end)
  probe('insert chain 2', function() local e = P.Plain{P.Str'x'} for i = 1, 2 do local d = P.Div{} d.content:insert(e) e = d end return #tostring(e), #P.json.encode(e) end)
  probe('insert chain 24', function() local e = P.Plain{P.Str'x'} for i = 1, 24 do local d = P.Div{} d.content:insert(e) e = d end return #tostring(e), #P.json.encode(e) end)
  probe('insert chain 25', function() local e = P.Plain{P.Str'x'} for i = 1, 25 do local d = P.Div{} d.content:insert(e) e = d end return #tostring(e), #P.json.encode(e) end)
  probe('insert chain 30', function() local e = P.Plain{P.Str'x'} for i = 1, 30 do local d = P.Div{} d.content:insert(e) e = d end return #tostring(e), #P.json.encode(e) end)
  probe('insert chain 64', function() local e = P.Plain{P.Str'x'} for i = 1, 64 do local d = P.Div{} d.content:insert(e) e = d end return #tostring(e), #P.json.encode(e) end)
  probe('insert chain 100', function() local e = P.Plain{P.Str'x'} for i = 1, 100 do local d = P.Div{} d.content:insert(e) e = d end return #tostring(e), #P.json.encode(e) end)
  probe('insert chain 126', function() local e = P.Plain{P.Str'x'} for i = 1, 126 do local d = P.Div{} d.content:insert(e) e = d end return #tostring(e), #P.json.encode(e) end)
  probe('list chain 1', function() local l = P.BulletList{} local cur = l for i = 1, 1 do local n = P.BulletList{} cur.content = {{n}} cur = n end return #tostring(l), #P.json.encode(l) end)
  probe('list chain 24', function() local l = P.BulletList{} local cur = l for i = 1, 24 do local n = P.BulletList{} cur.content = {{n}} cur = n end return #tostring(l), #P.json.encode(l) end)
  probe('list chain 25', function() local l = P.BulletList{} local cur = l for i = 1, 25 do local n = P.BulletList{} cur.content = {{n}} cur = n end return #tostring(l), #P.json.encode(l) end)
  probe('list chain 30', function() local l = P.BulletList{} local cur = l for i = 1, 30 do local n = P.BulletList{} cur.content = {{n}} cur = n end return #tostring(l), #P.json.encode(l) end)
  probe('list chain 60', function() local l = P.BulletList{} local cur = l for i = 1, 60 do local n = P.BulletList{} cur.content = {{n}} cur = n end return #tostring(l), #P.json.encode(l) end)
  probe('span chain 10', function() local e = P.Str'x' for i = 1, 10 do local s = P.Span{} s.content = {e, P.Space()} s.attr.classes:insert('c' .. i) e = s end local p = P.Para{e} return #tostring(p), #P.utils.stringify(p) end)
  probe('span chain 40', function() local e = P.Str'x' for i = 1, 40 do local s = P.Span{} s.content = {e, P.Space()} s.attr.classes:insert('c' .. i) e = s end local p = P.Para{e} return #tostring(p), #P.utils.stringify(p) end)
  probe('span chain 100', function() local e = P.Str'x' for i = 1, 100 do local s = P.Span{} s.content = {e, P.Space()} s.attr.classes:insert('c' .. i) e = s end local p = P.Para{e} return #tostring(p), #P.utils.stringify(p) end)
  probe('shared child', function() local c = P.Div{} c.content:insert(P.Para'x') local d = P.Div{} d.content = {c, c, c} local e = P.Div{} e.content = {d, d} return #tostring(e), P.json.encode(e) end)
  probe('changed after read', function() local c = P.Div{} c.content:insert(P.Para'x') local d = P.Div{c} local s1 = tostring(d) c.content:insert(P.Para'y') d.content = {c} return s1 == tostring(d), #tostring(d) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter raw-bom empty small
﻿function Pandoc(d) d.meta.r = 'ok' return d end
@@@ filter raw-bom-shebang empty small
﻿#!/usr/bin/env pandoc lua
function Pandoc(d) d.meta.r = 'ok' return d end
@@@ filter raw-bom-twice empty small
﻿﻿function Pandoc(d) return d end
@@@ filter raw-lookup-order empty small
local log = {}
local f = setmetatable({}, {__index = function(_, k) log[#log + 1] = k return nil end})
return {f, {Pandoc = function(d) d.meta.r = table.concat(log, '|') return d end}}
@@@ filter raw-lookup-order-topdown empty small
local log = {}
local f = setmetatable({traverse = 'topdown'}, {__index = function(_, k) log[#log + 1] = k return nil end})
return {f, {Pandoc = function(d) d.meta.r = table.concat(log, '|') return d end}}
@@@ filter raw-lookup-order-walk empty small
function Pandoc(d) local log = {}
d:walk(setmetatable({}, {__index = function(_, k) log[#log + 1] = k return nil end}))
d.meta.r = table.concat(log, '|') return d end
